task.title: Change a person
task.shortdesc: Correct a name, a date or a place on a person's page.

prereq.p: Open the person first. shows how.

step.cmd: Scroll to the foot of the page and choose .

stepresult.p: The page itself turns into a form. The names are first, then the sex, the dates and the places.

info.p: To record another name for the person, choose under . says more.

step.cmd: Scroll to the foot of the form and choose .

stepresult.p: The page shows the new words.

result.p: Your changes are saved to the file as you go.
result.note: The button is on the same page. It removes the person. Read before you choose it.
